_note: the one look terminology of the artists' descriptions, built by tools/vision/unify_looks.py (docs/plans/2026-09-17-look-terminology.md): canonical terms with their variants, tags and levels; what was taken out as noise and why; the author's rulings, applied first

rulings._note: the author's and Claude's rulings, by name: `merge` {look: the look it is}, `noise` [looks that are not looks], `level` a floor the measure may raise but not lower, `keep` a look the screens would drop. A family ruling ('all X ...') is expanded over the names known when it was made and never against names a later sweep invents -- those come up for review instead. A merge is followed to its end: into a removed look it is removed too.

meaning._note: merges by meaning: close terms by the embedding model (nomic, cosine >= 0.88), each judged by every text model in 'judges' against one canonical term; a merge needs all of them; judgments kept for reruns
